certification.name: IBM Ethical Hacking with Open Source Tools Professional Certificate
certification.description: Six-course program on ethical hacking with Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark and OpenVAS, covering reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, exploitation, reporting and incident response. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 2 months at 10 hours a week.
